entities.summary: The Great Mosque of Amêdî, also spelled as the Great Mosque of Amadiya, is a mosque in the town of Amêdî, Kurdistan, Iraq. It was founded in 1177 CE during the Abbasid era, and has been renovated several times throughout its history.
